name: Korinek et al. 2026 faithful port: rental rate pegged by world capital markets (epsilon = infinity)
description: Sensitivity overlay from Table 5 (p.37): capital is supplied at the no-AI rental rate, epsilon = infinity, written invEps = 0 (the capital-market roots then sit at Delta ln r = 0 exactly). Applied to the base file it is the Substantial epsilon = infinity column of Table 5; its tests assert that column. Combine with the Modest or Extreme overlay for the other scenarios (the Extreme column is checked in src/core/korinekFaithful.test.ts).

source.note: Robustness setting of the paper, not its calibration (epsilon = 3).
